questions.ask: Could you tell me your date of birth, please?
What are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you say your date of birth again, with the month as a word, please?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product"; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: "I already paid": a payment of this past-due amount only.
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period such as "next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes".
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.
intents.human: A request to speak to a human.

lines.opening: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only share the reason for my call with {title} {last_name} once I have checked who I am speaking with.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I do not have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. It will only take a moment.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: Could you suggest another time today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only arrange a call today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm.
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: The security questions protect your account, and I can only continue once they are answered.
lines.id_declined: I understand. I cannot continue without the security questions.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I could not confirm your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due, and it is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. The rest stays overdue, but could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.offer_floor: I understand. The rest stays overdue, but could you pay {amount}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I cannot record an amount below {floor}.
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, I cannot record that amount.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, the date must be today or later.
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Could you pay by {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can use is {deadline}.
lines.recorded: Thank you. Your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I will not take a promise today.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with a colleague who can discuss that with you.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with first?
lines.transfer: I am transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: A promise cannot be changed or cancelled on this call. You can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.

assumptions: The brief names no currency. Defaulted currency_word to 'dollars'.
Workdays are Monday to Friday (rule 7 dates section). Holidays are taken exactly as listed: 2026-10-26, 2026-11-11, 2026-11-26, 2026-12-25, 2027-01-01.
Rule 22 ('next Friday' said on a Friday = Friday of the following week) maps to next_weekday = following_week.
Rule 3 (ask once more, then close as unclear) gives confirm.max_asks = 2.
Rule 7 (ask once more for another time) gives callback.max_asks = 2. The brief does not require the callback to be on a business day beyond 'next business day', so business_days_only = false.

Identity: the date of birth comes first, then the phone's last four digits, as the brief orders them. The date is sent as %Y-%m-%d and a date given only as numbers is read as day-month-year (rule 11).

Rule 13: the only hint value in the tool API is 'day_month_swapped'. The agent asks for the date of birth again with the month as a word, so the retry is a full date the service can check. The retry is not counted as a wrong answer.
Rule 15: asking what the call is about counts as declining, so purpose_is_decline = true. The brief does not say that other questions count as declining, so question_is_decline = false.
The verify response field names (ok, verified, all_verified, wrong_answers_left, hint) come from the tool API. verified is a boolean, so pass_values is empty.
Floor names: the brief only says 'the floor' (minimum_payment / instalment_amount). They are spoken as 'minimum payment' and 'instalment amount'.
Amounts in the API are plain numbers with no mention of minor units, so amount_scale = 1.

Ladder attempt 1 uses full_or_floor on the last business day of this week. The engine moves to the last business day of next week when today is that day (rule 30). Attempt 2 (late band only) is the floor on the deadline.
Deadlines are counted in business days, so they always land on a business day. deadline_adjust is set to the default previous_business_day.
The brief does not say whether to ask 'anything else' after a promise. Kept the default ask_anything_else = true.
Brief A never uses add_note, so notes.enabled = false and every note value is empty. The paid outcome has no reason, as the outcome table shows.
Brief A covers one product only. The multi settings keep their defaults and do not apply.
Rule 45: two 'I don't want to talk' statements end the call, so max_not_talk = 2.
Rule 1 requires saying the call is recorded. This is phrased as 'We record this call.' to avoid the word 'recorded' outside the promise lines.
Rule 36: a recorded promise cannot be changed on the call, and the customer is told to use the mobile app.
Rule 38's prescribed sentence is used exactly as sms_line. Rule 28 ('Can you make this payment today?'), rule 34 ('Do you confirm?') and rule 9 ('I am sorry for your loss.') are also used verbatim.
The responses mapping is left empty so the engine reads the success flag (ok) from the tool API.
